game.title: Little Wonders
game.description: Guide a crowd of little wanderers home through six moonlit puzzles. Assign eight classic jobs, dig through soft earth and build bridges, with pause-and-plan controls and local rescue records.
game.controls: Select a job, then click or tap a wanderer. Keys 1-8 choose jobs; Space/P pauses; F toggles 3x speed; R retries; L opens levels; H opens help. Jobs can be assigned while paused.
